newsitem.title: USA: Mizar says chairman/CEO Irwin resigns.
newsitem.headline: Mizar says chairman/CEO Irwin resigns.

text.p: Mizar Inc said that David Irwin, its chairman, chief executive officer and president, has resigned.
The company said Sam Smith, a former chairman of Landmark Graphics Inc, has been elected as chairman and, until a successor to Irwin is named, interim chief executive officer.
In the company's announcement, Smith noted that a "lack of concensus" on the company's growth strategies "precipitated a mutual agreement" that Irwin would resign as CEO.
The company said it began a search for a president to succeed Irwin in that role in February.
Mizar is a supplier of computing products for the real-time signal and image processing market.
